The DLMF sectorial complex expansion is specialized to the positive real axis, where the phase is zero. The zero-based Lean tail index k = 2 maps to source index j = 1, giving B₂/x³ after the two leading terms.

The DLMF sectorial complex expansion is specialized to the positive real axis, with positive order n. The zero-based Lean tail index k = 2 maps to source index j = 1, giving ((n+1)!/2!) B₂/x^(n+2); at n = 1 this reduces to the E8 tail.
